description: This file contains shell script tests for git push operations using a porcelain interface, including various scenarios such as atomic pushes, forced pushes, non-fast-forward pushes, and cleanup procedures.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the provided shell commands, and verifies output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting failure and checks for error conditions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares the current references in a repository with expected references.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes output to remove or normalize user-friendly or variable parts for comparison.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Transforms command output into a stable, user-friendly format for verification.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Stores expected output in a format suitable for comparison.
